SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL LEASE. ALL NAMES AND TERMS ARE INVENTED.

OFFICE LEASE

This Office Lease is made between Example Tower Owner LLC ("Landlord") and Sample Analytics Inc. ("Tenant").

1. PREMISES. Landlord leases to Tenant Suite 400 of the Building, containing 12,500 rentable square feet (the "Premises").

2. TERM.
2.1 The Term shall commence on March 1, 2026 (the "Commencement Date") and shall expire on February 28, 2031, unless sooner terminated.
3. RENT.
3.1 Base Rent. Tenant shall pay Base Rent at the following annual rates per rentable square foot:
March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027: $38.00
March 1, 2027 through February 29, 2028: $39.14
March 1, 2028 through February 28, 2031: $40.31
3.2 Abatement. Base Rent only shall be abated for the first three (3) full calendar months of the Term.
3.3 Security Deposit. Tenant shall deposit with Landlord a security deposit of $95,000.

4. OPERATING EXPENSES.
4.1 Tenant's Share is 8.25%.
4.2 Controllable Operating Expenses shall not increase by more than five percent (5%) per year over the prior year, on a non-cumulative basis.
5. OPTIONS.
5.1 Renewal. Tenant shall have one (1) option to extend the Term for sixty (60) months by written notice given at least twelve (12) months before expiration, at ninety-five percent (95%) of Fair Market Rent.

6. ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
